prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.ts with named exports.
Required API: export function escapeLogFields(fields: readonly string[]): string
Behavior: Serialize fields separated by a literal tab. Inside each field escape backslash as \\, tab as \t, LF as \n, and CR as \r, in that precedence. An empty list serializes to the empty string.
Visible example: Fields ["a<TAB>b", "c\d"] serialize as a\tb<TAB>c\\d, where <TAB> denotes a literal tab.

Buggy source to repair:

export const escapeLogFields=(fields:readonly string[]):string=>fields.join('\t')

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
